utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Good afternoon, ladies and gentlemen. Could the Registrar please call the case.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Case Number IT-03-69-I, the Prosecutor versus Franko Simatovic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Thank you. May I have the appearances.

utterances.speaker: MS. SOMERS
utterances.text: Thank you, Your Honour. For the Prosecution, Susan Somers. Sitting in to assist administratively Ms. Britanny Kesselman and Ms. Stephanie Wee, case manager. Ms. Camille Bibles was unable to attend.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Thank you, Ms. Somers. And for the Defence, please. Push the button.

utterances.speaker: MS. GAJOVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Good afternoon, Your Honour. Good afternoon, ladies and gentlemen from the Prosecution. I'm Neda Gajovic, attorney from Belgrade. I will head the Defence counsel for Mr. Franko Simatovic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Thank you, Ms. Gajovic. This proceeding is the initial appearance of Mr. Franko Simatovic pursuant to Rule 62 of the Rules of Procedure and Evidence. Mr. Simatovic, if you could please rise and answer some questions. Can you hear the proceedings in a language you understand?

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Yes, I can.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: I will not continually ask you the same question this afternoon. But if a related problem arises, please do not hesitate to let me know. Then, would you please state your full name.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Franko Simatovic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Do you have any nickname?

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Yes, I have. Frenki.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: And would you please state your date and place of your birth.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] The 1st of April, 1950, in Belgrade, the former Yugoslavia.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Thank you, Mr. Simatovic. Please take a seat. The indictment against the accused, Mr. Simatovic, was reviewed and confirmed by a Judge of this Tribunal on the 1st of May of 2003. Subsequently, the authorities of Republic of Serbia which were holding the accused in custody transferred the accused to the Detention Unit of this Tribunal on Friday, 30th of May, 2003. Upon transfer of the accused, the President of the Tribunal assigned this case to Trial Chamber III, and as one of its permanent Judges, I have been designated as a Pre-Trial Judge. At the initial appearance proceeding, the Judge is to be satisfied that the accused understands the indictment against him. Ms. Gajovic, if you could tell me whether your client has received a copy of the indictment in a language he understands.

utterances.speaker: MS. GAJOVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] I wish to assure you, Your Honour, that the accused has received a copy of the indictment, that he understands the indictment, and that he will plead on all counts of the indictment today. And with your permission, I would like to suggest that the indictment not be read out.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Thank you. Very well. Then we've come to the most important formality of the initial appearances, that is, plea to the charges of the indictment. Then I will now proceed to ask the Registrar to read out each count of the indictment and to ask Mr. Simatovic whether he pleads guilty or not guilty. When pleading, Mr. Simatovic, confine your answer either to "guilty" or "not guilty." If you could stand up, please. Madam Registrar, please read out counts in the indictment.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Count 1, persecutions on political, racial, or religious grounds, a crime against humanity, punishable under Articles 5(h) and 7(1) of the Statute of the Tribunal.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Mr. Simatovic, do you plead guilty or not guilty to count 1?

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Your Honour, not guilty.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Very well. Now, please read count 2.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Count 2: Murder, a crime against humanity, punishable under Articles 5(a) and 7(1) of the Statute of the Tribunal.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Mr. Simatovic, how do you plead to count 2?

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Your Honour, not guilty.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Very well. Count 3, please.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Count 3: Murder, a violation of the laws or customs of war, as recognised by common article 3(1)(a) of the Geneva Conventions of 1949, punishable under Articles 3 and 7(1) of the Statute of the Tribunal.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Mr. Simatovic, do you plead guilty or not guilty to count 3?

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Your Honour, not guilty.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Very well. Count 4, please.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Count 4, deportation, a crime against humanity punishable Articles 5(d) and 7(1) of the Statute of the Tribunal.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Mr. Simatovic, do you plead guilty or not guilty?

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Your Honour, not guilty.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Would you please read the last count, count 5.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Count 5, inhumane acts, forcible transfer, a crime against humanity, punishable under Articles 5(i) and 7(1) of the Statute of the Tribunal.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Mr. Simatovic, how do you plead?

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Your Honour, not guilty.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Very well. Please sit down, Mr. Simatovic. I would like to ask the Registrar to note that Mr. Simatovic has pleaded not guilty to all five counts of the indictment. Then, as a next step, I must now remind the Prosecution that pursuant to Rule 66 (A)(i) of the Rules of Procedure and Evidence, it has 30 days to disclose to the Defence in a language which the accused understands all the supporting materials which accompanied the indictment when confirmation was sought. Also, all prior statements obtained by the Prosecution from the accused must be disclosed as well.

utterances.speaker: MS. SOMERS
utterances.text: Thank you very much, Your Honour. The Prosecution is duly aware and is in the process of collecting and processing such materials for disclosure to the Defence. We have spoken with Mrs. Gajovic about this and have indicated that there will be certain preliminary, initial motions for protective measures, of course, that I'm sure the Chamber will be expecting. Thank you very much.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Thank you. And for the Defence, it will have a 30-day period for filing any preliminary motions that it may care to do once it has received all of the supporting material in accordance with Rule 66 of the Rules of Procedure and Evidence. And finally, a Status Conference is to be held roughly within about four months time from now. And before that, pursuant to Rule 65 ter, the Pre-Trial Judge may be assisted in the performances of his duty by one of the Senior Legal Officers assigned to Chambers. So in this regard, Ms. Yvonne Featherstone, our Senior Legal Officer, shall undertake this task. So accordingly, Ms. Featherstone will meet you, meet with the parties, to discuss the various matters arising from preparation of the trial. And I wonder if there is any matter the parties wish to raise at this stage? Prosecution.

utterances.speaker: MS. SOMERS
utterances.text: Nothing at this time, Your Honour. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Thank you. For the Defence?

utterances.speaker: MS. GAJOVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] We have nothing at this moment either, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Thank you. Mr. Simatovic, is there anything you'd like to raise regarding your custody or anything else?

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] No, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Very well. You may sit down, please. Unless there's anything the parties wish to raise, this proceeding is now adjourned.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: at 3.12 p.m.
